Editorial Eye-Strip Poster (ref 12)

Layered composite · Proven best · 1 photo
postereditorialbwlayeredcode
Ref 12, the most complex one, now built properly: blurred greyscale wall, a mock Instagram post (avatar, handle, music line, heart / 2,211 / 880 / bookmark bar), your subject cut out with rembg so she BREAKS OUT of the post frame, big semi-transparent name type behind her, a script signature and a WOMEN AESTHETICS footer. All text is customisable. Run `python3 tools/composites.py <your-photo.jpg>`. Needs `pip install rembg onnxruntime` for the cut-out (use the light u2netp model — the 1GB bria model runs out of RAM); without it the poster still builds, minus the cut-out.
